children: Kalshi faces a Monday New York hearing on Attorney General Letitia James' proposed order, which it says would shut the exchange nationwide. Justice Melissa Crane will hear James' temporary restraining-order request at 11:30 a.m. ET, according to The Block, after a federal judge on Friday rejected the CFTC's second emergency bid to block the state case. James' proposal would bar Kalshi from operating an unlicensed gambling business “within or from New York or to persons in New York,” restrict trading by users under 21 and prohibit campus advertising. Kalshi says the order could force nationwide closure and liquidation of open positions; the CFTC argues federal law preempts state gaming rules.

title: Kalshi Faces Monday Hearing on New York Order It Says Would Shut Down Its Exchange Nationwide
